description:
Apply configurable discard thresholds to segmented OSD search under the implementation-produced complexity policy.

## Background

Thresholds are optional normal-priority work. They may skip candidates only through the documented segment metric and must leave baseline exhaustive search unchanged when disabled.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Applies documented threshold comparisons at deterministic segment boundaries.
- [hard] REQ-02: Reports discarded-pattern, tested-candidate, elimination, and termination counters without counting a discarded pattern as tested.
- [hard] REQ-03: Preserves exhaustive baseline results when thresholds are disabled.
- [hard] REQ-04: Covers threshold equality, no-discard, full-discard, cap, and cancellation cases in engine-local tests.
- [hard] REQ-05: Documents that thresholded results are policy-bounded approximations rather than exhaustive order-$m$ search.
title: OSD discard thresholds
